status.comment: Local Linux MVP is in progress. Focused native receipts exist; broader platform and interaction capabilities remain unproven.

p.identity: The package coordinate is org.vibevm.podbay/podbay at preproduction version 0.1.0. PodBay is an independent OS runtime. Zap may consume PodBay through its public contract; PodBay has no dependency on Zap.

p.roles: Coordinator and worker are roles of the same pod model. A root Coordinator/Service now has focused local Linux launch evidence. Delegated Worker/Task admission is a separate deferred parent-authorised path; a provider-native child thread is not a PodBay Worker Run.

p.crates: The Cargo workspace contains core, wire, store, host, pod, client and CLI crates. Core has no internal dependency; wire, store, host and client may depend on core; pod depends on core and the platform resource crates it needs; CLI depends on client-facing contracts. Pod does not depend on the manager-facing host crate. Provider adapters and an optional ACP gateway must not reverse this direction.

p.boundary: Focused Linux receipts now cover systemd pod supervision, durable command admission, authenticated owner and socket reads, Codex V2 root/bootstrap/native output, exact operator stop, UntilStopped service lifetime, and a nested disposable Zap-to-PodBay-to-fake-Codex run across manager rebind. Zap's disposable path now proves bootstrap readiness, later-turn settlement, and one explicit final-answer chat reply. The live VibeVM Wayfinder has not yet been switched to this generation. Durable production PTY viewing/control, delegated workers, host requests/permissions, remote execution, macOS and Windows backends, and the optional ACP gateway are deferred by the owner; see POST-MVP-CAMPAIGN.md.

p.post-mvp-campaign: The owner's 2026-10-05 scope is local Linux MVP, then PodBay-backed Zap, then VibeVM development. Remote computers, macOS, Windows, delegated Worker/Task admission, host requests and permissions, and the outward ACP gateway are deferred. Before planning any broader prototype, read the full repository-root POST-MVP-CAMPAIGN.md; it records each deferred phase and native acceptance gate. The roadmap does not activate those phases or block the current VibeVM start gate.
